datasheet.title: Evolution Cable Management System data sheet

description: 2U Evolution horizontal cable manager with grommets, Chatsworth Products 33549-X02 (33549-702 black, 33549-E02 Glacier White): a steel back plate the full 19 in EIA width that bolts to the rack rails and stands 208 mm out, with a row of ten plastic T-shaped cable guides (fingers) along its top and along its bottom, nine slots in each a cable is laid in through, and a contoured snap-on front door that closes the manager and swings open up or down or lifts off. Three grommets in the back plate close the openings cables cross to the other side.

gaps.note: the maker says the door "opens up or down" and can be removed; the format has no hinge, so the door is drawn as one fitted plate that lifts off, and the swing is not stated.
gaps.wanted: a format that can say a hinged cover, and a close picture of the door's edge

gaps.note: the format's pass-through covers are `open` and `brush`, with no grommet: each grommet's opening is declared `open` at the opening's size, and the membrane and slit the picture shows across it are not stated.
gaps.wanted: a pass-through cover for a grommet, and a dimensioned drawing of one

gaps.note: the installation instructions give "two to four" equipment mounting screws for the range of heights and "one screw for every mounting hole", and no document gives the holes' positions or count for this height.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the back plate

gaps.note: no document dimensions a grommet or the plate it sits in, and the one picture is of a 3U part; the size and position here are read off it by the part's height.

body.description: the steel back plate with its ears and the grommets' openings

door.description: the snap-on front door over the finger heads

fingers.description: the two rows of fingers, ten a row, upper row first

name: 33549-x02

attrs.note: datasheet - materials, finishes and the indoor-only statement are the data sheet's specifications table (page 2, "Steel, aluminum, and plastic T-shaped cable guides"; "Black or Glacier White powder coat paint"; "For indoor use only, in environmentally controlled areas; may not be used outdoors, in harsh environments or in air-handling spaces"). BABA compliance is the product page's. The part is not RoHS-stated by any document held.

bottom.note: estimated - the pictures show the same fingers along the bottom as along the top; the bottom is the top again.

capacity.note: datasheet - the maker's CPI Cable Fill Table (updated 2024; the data sheet's "Cable Fill" row points to chatsworth.com/cablefill, which links it) lists 33549-X02, Evolution Horizontal Cable Manager, Grommet, 2U: interior width 2.6 in, interior depth 6.5 in, usable area 17.0 sq in; recommended fill 135 Cat 5e (0.200 in OD), 87 Cat 6 (0.250 in) and 60 Cat 6a (0.300 in); maximum fill 271, 173 and 120. The table's notes give recommended as 25% of the usable area and maximum as 50%. The figure stated is the maximum for Cat 6, 173, as the FS managers state their theoretical maximum for Cat6; the recommended 87 is in the basis.

chassis.note: datasheet - 2U x 19" EIA x 8.2" (208 mm) for 33549-X02 in the data sheet's ordering table, chassis style with grommets, and 3.5 in (89 mm) high, 19 in (483 mm) wide, 8.2 in (208 mm) deep on the product page for 33549-702. The width is the 482.6 of 19 in EIA, ears included, as a rack-face part is its ears and what hangs off them. The height is the 88.9 of two units at the EIA-310 1.75 in. The depth is the maker's overall projection from the rail face, door and fingers included, and not a body depth.

color.note: estimated - black, or Glacier White (the colour letter X in the part number: 7 black, E Glacier White). The black is the maker's renders'; the Glacier White shade is not given by any document and is drawn a light grey.

door.note: datasheet - "Contoured, snap-on front door opens up or down" (data sheet and product page), "The cover will open up or down and can be removed when cabling" (installation instructions). The door is its own part, fitted as shipped, so a drawing can take it off and show the fingers; the format has no hinge, so that it swings up or down is a gap.

ears.note: estimated - the 16.3 of ear each end is half of the 32.6 between the 450.0 the manager's body is taken to fill (the EIA-310 clear opening between the rails, 17.72 in, to 450) and the 482.6 overall. No document gives the ear width. The ears are the ends of the back plate and are drawn with it, as the rack-face FS parts draw theirs; their mounting holes are not drawn, because the installation instructions give only "two to four" screws for the whole range of heights and no hole position.

fingers.note: estimated - T-SHAPED FINGERS, TOP AND BOTTOM, ON THE FRONT ONLY. The data sheet and installation instructions show the plastic T-shaped cable guides along the top edge and the bottom edge of the manager, standing from the back plate to the door (step 1: "the cover snaps onto the ends of the plastic, T-shaped cable guides (fingers)"). Nothing is on the back plate's far side. Ten fingers a row (nine slots counted across the width in the data sheet pictures), 45.0 pitch, a 24.0 slot and a head that leaves an 8.0 neck. The finger plate is 11.4 thick: (88.9 - 66.0) / 2 from the maker's interior width of 2.6 in. The pitch, slot and head are read off the pictures against the 450.0 between the ears and carry no tolerance.

front.note: estimated - the door, fitted. With it off, the two rows of finger heads, and the back plate's three round openings the grommets fill. The `duct` guide is the 66.1 between the finger plates (88.9 less 2 x 11.4), the cable fill table's interior width of 2.6 in (66.0 mm), over the 450.0 between the ears.

guides.note: estimated - the duct on the front view is the channel between the finger plates, run across the rack; finger pitch 45.0 and slot 24.0 as `fingers`.

left.note: estimated - the side: the back plate, the two finger plates 11.4 high with the cable space 66.1 between them, and the door's face and returns at the front. No picture of the maker's is a side elevation; it is built from the front and plan figures.

method.note: FIGURES FROM A DATA SHEET TABLE AND FROM PICTURES. The Evolution Cable Management System data sheet (page 3, Evolution Horizontal Cable Managers table) states each part's height in rack units, 19" EIA, 8.2" (208 mm) deep, chassis style and shipping weight, and its pictures show the four chassis styles; the installation instructions (IIS-735441, Rev.3) draw the door off and on. NO DOCUMENT HOLDS A DIMENSIONED DRAWING: every figure below that is not the data sheet's table is read off a render or a line drawing and is `estimated`, with how. The maker's cable fill table (CPI Cable Fill Table, 2024) gives the interior width and depth of the manager, which fixes the finger plate and the cable space. The picture of the grommets is of a 3U part; the 2U part is drawn as the same manager made shorter.

mount.note: drawing - the installation instructions' steps 2 and 3: the chassis is aligned to the desired rack unit and the mounting holes at its back line up with the rack's holes, one screw for every hole, "two to four" in all depending on the height. So the part bolts to the rail face at a rack unit and stands out from it, which is what `rack-face` says. The FS horizontal ducts are `rack` parts that state their units, so whether this line is `rack-face` or `rack` is a choice the pull request asks the owner to accept.

passes.note: estimated - each grommet's opening is declared a pass-through with `cover: open`, at the opening's size: the format has no grommet, and a cover is `open` or `brush` today. A cable crosses the back plate through each opening from the front to the rear. The openings are round and each is declared `rect`, at the bore's side: an `obround` of equal sides compiles to a hole of no width in rack.json, which no cable could cross.

rear.note: estimated - THE BACK PLATE WITH ITS THREE GROMMETS. The data sheet's one picture of the grommets (page 3, "Grommets shown", a 3U part) shows a plate of three round grommets fitted at one end of the back plate and the same plate beside the part. Each is drawn as a ring 44.5 across (0.5 of the part's height) round an opening 35.6 across (0.8 of that), centred on the height, 51.2 apart, the last 52.3 in from the end of the 450.0 between the ears, as seen from the front. The picture is a perspective render of a 3U part, so the figures carry a few millimetres. The grommets are drawn as open rings: the picture shows a membrane across each with a slit, which the format cannot say. The plate's ears are the ends of the plate; their mounting holes are not drawn.

shell.note: estimated - A SHEET BODY, NOT A BOX: the back plate as a well 206 deep whose floor is open at the three grommet openings, the two rows of fingers standing in it, the door in it across the finger heads, which lifts off and opens the manager. The data sheet says "welded and riveted frame/door attaches to all CPI Rack Systems with supplied tool-less mounting hardware".

thickness.note: estimated - no document states a gauge. 1.5 is the steel of comparable rack-face parts in this library (the FS FHD-CMP5DR, 1.5 mm cold-rolled), since the data sheet says only "steel, aluminum, and plastic T-shaped cable guides".

top.note: estimated - the plan, rear at y=0: the back plate 2.0 thick, the finger plate to the door, nine slots 24.0 wide on a 45.0 pitch from 22 to 186 deep with rounded roots, narrowing to the 8.0 neck under the door's 16 mm return. Read off the data sheet pictures; no view of the maker's is orthographic.

weight.note: datasheet - 4 lb (1.8 kg) in the data sheet's ordering table: its column is SHIPPING weight, so the carton is in it and the manager itself weighs less. No net weight is stated by any document held; the figure is stated as the weight so the part has one, and is an upper bound.
